# Hack pad main board

**Draft in progress. Not built, not reviewed, not complete.** The schematic is generated by
`hardware/scripts/hackpad_design.py`; `data/` holds the cross-checked NXP facts it is drawn from (ball map, pin
functions, supplies, boot, memory wiring, the evaluation board's part values) with their sources.

Drawn so far: the brain (NXP i.MX RT1176, 289 balls) with its supplies and decoupling, clocks, reset, boot
selection, debug, 64 MB of SDRAM and the boot flash. 178 of 289 balls are connected; the rest wait for the sheets
still to come (power input and battery, display, keyboard, card, USB, audio, radios, SDR, sensors, bench tools).

Parts still to be chosen on these sheets, marked TBD in the schematic: the converter inductor, the two crystals,
and the exact RT1176 part number. See [the system plan](../../docs/hack-pad-architecture.md).
